text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Shinko Windy seemed to be
creeping and sneaking around, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Prankster!
What kind of mischief are you cookin' up today~?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You can tell just by looking, it's a pitfall!
If I set it near the hollow,
someone's bound to fall in for suuure~♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Air Groove!? N-N-No way!
Windy-chan didn't dig any pitfall—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaa! You totally fell for it!
It's a joke!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Sowwy sowwy♪ But since we're doing it,
wouldn't a bigger pitfall be better, NO?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's throw some water balloons in too!
They'll serve as cushions, and when they pop—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm soaking wet!
I have a great idea! Let's get it ready right aw—!?

Ho, I see.
Is there anything else...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see...
Maybe mixing colors in the water balloons...?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aah... Taiki... Behind you!
Air Groove is right behind you...!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Non-non! I won't fall for
that prank, no way~♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I-It's not a prank, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's that very 'no way'. We'll hear the rest in the student council room.
You two, follow me...!"
